topic: The Road to 1500 Locations with Tianna Strateman of Club Pilates

facts.label: Story
facts.value: The Road to 1500 Locations with Tianna Strateman of Club Pilates

facts.label: Article
facts.value: For a brand approaching its 20th anniversary and reaching its 1500th location, standing still isn’t an option. Tianna Strateman, the brand president of Club Pilates, joined the podcast to explain how the brand is evolving on two fronts at once: introducing a new circuit-style class format and rolling out studio refreshes system-wide, all while protecting the member experience that got it here. Strateman sat down with Club Solutions editor and podcast host Taylor Gabhart to discuss the signals that led Club Pilates to build the new class offering, how the brand designed the studio refreshes to minimize disruption and maximize ROI for franchisees, and what KPIs the brand tracks to measure success of a system-wide launch. The conversations offers insights for any operator weighing how to innovate without losing what made their brand work in the first place. Club Solutions Magazine · The Road to 1500 Locations with Tianna Strateman of Club Pilates Show Notes: At 0:25, Strateman shares her path to brand president, from joining Club Pilates as VP of training and experience over eight years ago to leading the brand today. Strateman explains the two industry signals — the rise of strength training and GLP-1use — that pointed Club Pilates toward building a circuit style class at 1:45.

en.headline: The Road to 1500 Locations with Tianna Strateman of Club Pilates

facts.value: Okemos, Michigan, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Careerz Group today announced Careerz Coach AI, a connected AI coaching system designed to help managers apply completed workforce assessment data to everyday people and workplace questions. Careerz Group today announced Careerz Coach AI, a connected AI coaching system that allows Careerz Group Workforce Solutions clients to ask questions about people and workplace situations and receive guidance informed by assessment data already completed within their workforce program. Rather than beginning with a generic AI prompt, Careerz Coach AI can draw from relevant assessment information available for the user, including supported data from assessments such as JPTI, DISC, Motivators and emotional intelligence. “The value of an assessment should not end when someone finishes reading the report,” said Melissa L. topic: What Belonging Has to Do with Mental Wellbeing at Work

facts.label: Story
facts.value: What Belonging Has to Do with Mental Wellbeing at Work

facts.label: Article
facts.value: While we are talking more about mental health, and there is even a day set aside to highlight its importance, are having the conversations we need to have about the way a workplace culture informs our mental wellbeing? I don’t think so. Many companies may see wellbeing as a program or an initiative. In this case, there may be relevant and informative presentations, the possibility of a lunchtime yoga class, or a robust insurance program alongside the Employee Assistance Plan. But these things are important and can be helpful. But they are only truly supportive if the culture we work in every day has a positive impact on our mental health. Otherwise, at best, they give us only temporary relief. Stress When we think about mental wellness, stress is an important factor to consider. Stress at work comes in many forms. Some comes from the leaders we report to (unreasonable timelines, being expected to respond to emails at all hours, micromanagement). Some is self-imposed (working late, skipping lunch). Some is lateral (exclusion by colleagues, “jokes” in the lunchroom, harassment). But a large cause of stress is lack of belonging. And belonging is tied to workplace culture. Workplace Culture Since leaders are instrumental in shaping culture, we need to consider how we are supporting a healthy workplace community where people can speak up, and also share ideas and concerns.

en.headline: What Belonging Has to Do with Mental Wellbeing at Work
